rationale: Independent Roman and Jewish testimony plus Pilate-era context; substrate-level attestation of a person's existence, not of any metaphysics.
Scholars split on the empty tomb as datum; Ludemann and Crossan reject; no evidence state separates resurrection from ordinary-history rivals.
Pre-Pauline creed dated within years of the crucifixion; confirms early testimony's existence, not its truth; no rival metaphysics differs.
1961 Caesarea inscription names Pilate; confirms a person existed. Both theistic and non-theistic rivals predict the same attestation.
1990 ossuary naming Caiaphas, Golan acquitted of forgery; consensus accepts it; no differential consequence for any metaphysics.
Tel Dan stele's 'house of David' supports David's historicity; minimalists debate details; rivals agree on whether the king existed.
Neo-Babylonian ration tablets naming Jehoiachin of Judah; routine attestation shared by every metaphysical reading.
Dead Sea Isaiah Scroll agrees with Masoretic text; confirms transmission stability, silent on doctrine; all rivals expect the same.
Sana'a and Birmingham manuscripts date early; Uthmanic selection involved orthographic choices; substrate claim confirmed, metaphysics untouched.
No Sinai toponyms or conquest horizon; mainstream locates origins in Iron Age I settlement; the biblical-scale claim lacks support.
Kuntillet Ajrud pithoi invoke YHWH with his Asherah; practice was not exclusive-monotheistic; rivals differ on metaphysics, not the inscription.
Collins dates final form c.165 BCE; accurate to 167 BCE and wrong at 11:44-45; late composition confirmed, prediction fails.
Mainland Tyre destroyed 6th c. BCE but modern Sour is inhabited; literal 'never rebuilt' fails, though exegesis rescues the text.
Nag Hammadi codices are 4th-5th c. copies; mainstream dates Thomas to 2nd c. CE; suppression claim unsupported.
Native maternal lineages are Siberian; no accepted archaeological correlates; limited-geography apologetics remain contested, not confirming.
Three labs date the linen 1260-1390 CE; contamination hypotheses disputed; the date itself is substrate, not a metaphysical discriminator.
STEP trial, n=1,802, found no difference in complications; null under the best protocol; no tradition-specific effect to register.
70 certified cures since 1858, but spontaneous remission base rates explain the pattern; the anomaly is not deity-specific.
No observatory recorded any solar disturbance on 1917-10-13; crowd effects and cloud optics suffice; no rival metaphysics predicts differently.
Luminous forms photographed and crowds attested, but cause unresolved; witnesses crossed confessional lines, so occurrence lacks theological specificity.
Capillary action and surface tension moved the milk; icons of different deities behaved identically, so the result is non-discriminating.
Exudates explained by moisture and mineral leaching, or shown fraudulent; Windsor case judged non-supernatural by its own diocese.
Wounds documented and healed without scarring, yet self-infliction allegations persist; assessments split, so the claim stays contested.
Randi's 1986 recording caught names read off prayer cards through a hidden earpiece; the mechanism is mundane deception.
Over 1,000 applicants, none passed the pre-agreed challenge; an aggregate null, self-selection caveat noted.
AWARE: 2,060 arrests, 15 centres; no hidden target identified, defeating the predicted separable-consciousness signature.
Granqvist et al. 2005 tracked suggestibility, not field exposure; small-n SPECT studies; no deity-specific neural signature.
Christian NDEs meet Jesus, Hindu NDEs meet Yama's messengers; content tracks prior culture, so the shared-realm claim weakens.
Stevenson's ~2,500 cases cluster where belief in reincarnation exists; cryptomnesia and suggestion confounders unresolved.
Millerites 1844, Camping 2011, JW dates all failed; failed dated predictions are counted here, no rival metaphysics in play.
Haile Selassie's death in 1975 is verified; the literal divine-incarnation claim fails, though non-literal readings absorb it.
The shoal is a real tombolo on satellite and marine-geology data; existence confirmed, mythic attribution untested by the feature.
Claims cluster in every tradition with incompatible deities; testimony is parity-symmetric, so no rival pair is differentially predicted.
Planck fixes 13.787 plus or minus 0.020 Gyr; equally consistent with ex-nihilo creation and with eternal-inflation or cyclic models.
The strong-force window is about 2% and the cosmological constant about 1 in 10^120; theistic, multiverse and selection priors survive.
Geocentric phrasings lose to astronomy, Galileo to Vatican 1992; literalism disconfirmed while the creator question is untouched.
One kalpa (~4.32-8.64 Gyr) numerically overlaps Earth's 4.54 Gyr; coincidence confirmed, but insight and discrimination are not.
Confirmed recovery beyond placebo and remission base-rate; interventionist theism predicts it, deism predicts no such effect.
The ink and radiocarbon date the Vinland Map to the 1920s; no live rival metaphysics yields a different observable here.
